# device42_rack (Resource)


## Exemple 

```hcl
resource "device42_rack" "myNewRack" {
    name          = "myNewRack"
    size          = 42
    building      = "myNewBuilding"
    room          = "myNewRoom"
    manufacturer  = "APC"
    tags          = "Prod,East"
    custom_fields = {
        "rack_type" = "server"
    }
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the rack. ForceNew.
- `size` (Number) Size of the rack (number of U).

### Optional

- `building` (String) Name of the building that contains this rack.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Any custom fields that will be used in device42.
- `manufacturer` (String) Rack manufacturer.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes.
- `orientation` (String) Orientation of the rack: left, right, up or down.
- `room` (String) Name of the room that contains this rack.
- `room_id` (Number) ID of the room that contains this rack (used when room name is not unique).
- `row` (String) Row name of the rack.
- `tags` (String) Add or update tags to a rack (comma separated).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the rack.
